messages:
Nia (CSM): Weekly health check for BlueOak 1: focusing on error mix and top endpoints causing customer friction
Nia (CSM): Short summary: request volume steady (~1.05M), error rate up from 1.9% -> 3.2% WoW. Majority are server 5xx during nightly workloads and timeouts on embeddings during onboarding backfills. Small cluster of 429s on streaming chat during spikes.
Nia (CSM): Snapshot numbers: total requests 1,050,321; total errors 33,610 (3.2%); breakdown -> 5xx 21,120 (63%), timeouts 8,405 (25%), rate_limit/429 4,085 (12%)
Nia (CSM): Top endpoints (ranked by error count):
- POST /v1/generate: 14,300 errors (predominantly 5xx). Peak window 02:10-02:35 UTC.
- POST /v1/embeddings: 7,900 timeouts, median latency 2200ms during backfills.
- POST /v1/chat/stream: 3,600 rate_limit (429) responses, plus ~480 timeouts during short bursts.
- POST /v1/batch/submit: 2,810 mixed errors (5xx + timeout) correlated with large payload sizes >20k tokens.
Arjun (SRE): Can you drop a sample stacktrace or logs from /v1/generate around 02:15 UTC? Need to check for model load churn or eviction.
Nia (CSM): Pasted sample from logs:
```
[02:16:02 UTC] ERROR create_response: worker-5: 5xx upstream: model load failed, oom during decode
[02:16:03 UTC] WARN rpc: connection closed by peer
[02:16:03 UTC] INFO kvcache: miss -> recompute
```
Arjun (SRE): That looks like decode-phase OOMs. Could be sequences longer than expected or memory fragmentation. I'll correlate with GC/oom reports.
Kai (Support): Tickets: 4 inbound this week about embeddings timing out in onboarding flow. Two customers couldn't finish CSV->embeddings step. I've proposed a workaround to split files.
Rina (AE): Context for renewal: BlueOak is usage-heavy and likely to renew, but they asked for a mitigation plan before next exec review. We need a short customer-ready note.
HealthBot (bot): Health scan results: generate: high error rate; embeddings: intermittent timeouts; chat/stream: elevated 429s during peak; overall SLO for availability breached 99.5% -> 99.1% for the week.
Arjun (SRE): Short-term mitigations I suggest:
1) Add temporary soft-throttling on /v1/batch/submit and prefer smaller chunk sizes during known backfill windows.
2) Add 2 additional decode workers (scale up) for 02:00-03:30 UTC for next 3 nights.
3) Enable kvcache longer tail retention for generate to avoid recompute on repeated prefixes.
Nia (CSM): Operational note: BlueOak ran two backfills without sharding this week (10:22-11:04 PT Tue and 10:12-10:52 PT Wed). We recommended sharding last week.
Kai (Support): I'll send KB steps to customers recommending shard size ~500 records per job and provide a temporary priority queue for onboarding jobs if they accept.
Rina (AE): Customer note request: can we provide a one-page mitigation summary with ETA for fixes and suggested runbook changes? I'll attach to renewal packet.
Arjun (SRE): Action items (SRE):
- Pull OOM/GC logs for affected nodes + correlate with sequence lengths (ETA 12h).
- Roll temporary autoscaler tweak to add workers overnight (ETA 6h to stage, roll tonight).
- Add a guard in runtime to reject >X token single requests with a better error message (ETA 48h if we proceed).
Nia (CSM): Action items (CSM/Support):
- Draft customer one-pager and mitigation steps, share with @Rina by tomorrow morning.
- Confirm exact shard parameters BlueOak used and offer assisted re-run.
Kai (Support): I'll update the three tickets and offer a 1:1 troubleshooting session for the onboarding flow.
Arjun (SRE): If OOMs confirmed, priority is a memory threshold guard in runtime + backport. If it's fragmentation, we may need a config change to reduce concurrent decodes per worker.
Nia (CSM): Please post findings here when available. If we see another spike tonight, enable the temporary scaling immediately.
Rina (AE): Thanks team. Once we have the one-pager I'll send to the execs and include the proposed mitigations in renewal notes.
Nia (CSM): Closing: will follow up with customer copy + logs. :thumbsup:
